template_data.lead_html: Most small businesses wait for the RFP. Here's what we do instead.

rows.what_html: Pull the GSA Acquisition Forecast — flag every recompete within 12 months in their NAICS codes
Filter SAM.gov Sources Sought notices — early signals a contract is being shaped
Drop intel into a client folder — who holds it, was it set-aside, what's next

template_data.closer: PIPELINE IS BUILT BEFORE THE RFP DROPS.
